questions.stem:
—______ you ever ______ to the Shenzhen Museum?
—Yes, I ______ there last weekend with my classmates.
questions.explanation: 第一空根据'ever'（曾经）可知用现在完成时'Have...been'，表示曾经去过某地（已返回）；第二空根据'last weekend'（上周）这一具体过去时间状语，必须用一般过去时'went'。A选项第一空用Did与ever搭配不当；C选项第二空have been与last weekend冲突；D选项第一空时态错误。口诀：'ever/never用现完，yesterday/last week用过去'。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ cover is red belongs to the school library.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系词。先行词是'the book'，而从句中'cover'（封面）与先行词构成所属关系（the book's cover），因此用关系代词'whose'表示'……的'。A选项'who'指人；B和C选项'which/that'在从句中作主语或宾语，但此处从句不缺主宾，缺定语。技巧：先行词后紧跟名词时，考虑用whose。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The classroom ______ by students every Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 主语'The classroom'是动作'clean'的承受者，需用被动语态；时间状语'every Friday afternoon'表示经常性动作，用一般现在时被动语态'is cleaned'。A选项是主动语态第三人称单数；C选项是一般过去时被动，与every Friday时间状语不符；D选项是过去式或过去分词，不能单独作谓语。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—I wonder ______.
—You can take the subway Line 9 and get off at Shenzhen Bay Park Station.
options: A. how can I get to Shenzhen Bay Park
B. how I can get to Shenzhen Bay Park
C. where I can get to Shenzhen Bay Park
D. when I can get to Shenzhen Bay Park
questions.explanation: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主语+谓语），排除A选项的疑问语序；根据答句'你可以乘9号线……'可知问的是方式（how），不是地点（where）或时间（when）。C和D选项连接词与答句不符。技巧：宾从三步走——连词选择看句意，陈述语序莫忘记，时态主从要呼应。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The weather was terrible yesterday. It rained heavily, so we had to postpone our picnic until next Sunday. The word 'postpone' probably means ______.
questions.explanation: 根据上下文线索：因为下大雨（rained heavily），所以把野餐改到下周日（until next Sunday），说明是'推迟'而非取消。A选项'提前'与文意相反；C选项'取消'过于绝对，文中说的是改期；D选项'准备'不符合语境。猜词技巧：利用因果逻辑（so）和时间线索（until next Sunday）推断。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: If you add the prefix 'un-' to 'happy', you get 'unhappy', which means 'not happy'. Similarly, if you add 'un-' to 'comfortable', you get '______', meaning 'not comfortable'.
questions.explanation: 前缀'un-'加在形容词前表示否定，'comfortable'（舒适的）加'un-'变为'uncomfortable'（不舒适的）。'dis-'也是否定前缀，但通常不与comfortable搭配；'in-'加在以c开头的部分形容词前（如correct→incorrect），但comfortable习惯用un-。技巧：un-是最常见的否定前缀，适用于大多数形容词。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: As environmental volunteers, we decided to ______ old books and clothes to children in rural areas instead of throwing them away.
questions.explanation: 'give away'意为'赠送、捐赠'，符合句意'把旧书旧衣捐赠给农村儿童'。A选项'give up'意为'放弃'；C选项'give out'意为'分发、耗尽'；D选项'give in'意为'屈服、让步'。技巧：give短语辨析——away表分离（送出去），up表停止（放弃），out表向外（分发），in表向内（屈服）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，每个班都被要求'提出'一个节能创意计划，'come up with'意为'想出、提出'。B选项'catch up with'意为'追上'；C选项'keep up with'意为'跟上、保持同步'；D选项'put up with'意为'忍受'。语境线索：与'plan'搭配表示'制定/提出计划'。

questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a Green Campus Project. All students were encouraged to take part in it. The goal was to make our school more environmentally friendly.

Every class was asked to (8)______ a creative plan to save energy. My classmates and I had a heated discussion after school. Some suggested turning off the lights when leaving the classroom. Others proposed using both sides of the paper. Finally, we decided to create a small garden on the balcony of our classroom.

At first, we faced many (9)______. We didn't know which plants were suitable for the balcony environment. Also, we had to collect used bottles and boxes to make pots. It was hard work, but nobody (10)______. We searched for information online and asked our biology teacher for advice. Little by little, our garden began to take shape.

Two weeks later, our garden was finished. It not only beautified our classroom but also helped purify the air. When the judges came to (11)______ our work, they were impressed by our creativity and teamwork. Our class won the first prize!

This experience taught us that protecting the environment doesn't require big actions. Small efforts can also (12)______ a difference. We felt proud that we could contribute to a greener school.

questions.stem: According to the passage, how many hours of sleep do teenagers need every night?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文章第二段第一句'Scientists have found that teenagers need about 8-10 hours of sleep every night'可知，青少年每晚需要8-10小时睡眠。A选项6-7小时是文中提到的中国学生实际睡眠时间（less than 7 hours）；B和D选项与原文数据不符。技巧：细节题要精准定位原文，注意数字信息。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you often feel sleepy in class? Do you find it hard to concentrate on your studies? The answer might lie in your sleep habits.

Scientists have found that teenagers need about 8-10 hours of sleep every night. However, many students in China sleep less than 7 hours due to heavy schoolwork and the use of electronic devices (电子设备). This lack of sleep can affect both your health and academic performance.

When you sleep, your brain is actually very busy. It processes the information you learned during the day and moves it from short-term memory to long-term memory. This means that staying up late to study might seem productive, but it actually reduces your ability to remember things. As Dr. Li, a sleep researcher, explains, "Sleep is like saving files on a computer. Without enough sleep, your brain cannot properly store what you've learned."

Moreover, sleep deprivation (睡眠不足) can lead to mood swings and weakened immune systems. Students who don't get enough sleep are more likely to catch colds and feel irritable (易怒的).

To improve your sleep quality, experts suggest establishing a regular sleep schedule. Try to go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends. Also, avoid using smartphones or computers at least one hour before bedtime, as the blue light from screens can trick your brain into thinking it's still daytime.

Remember, good sleep is not a waste of time. It is an essential investment in your health and success.

B. Studying late at night is very effective for memory
